== Build notes: 2008 consolation results and source checks ==

Added 29th, marked dropped, in the Saturday consolation on 5 January 2008 and 18th in the Sunday consolation on 6 January 2008. Both use [[Premiere - Original VS14]] and the source's numbered standings.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18352#p255191 Saturday consolation standings], Players Committee Forums.</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=18322#p254691 Sunday consolation standings], Players Committee Forums.</ref> The existing 2008 Day 1 row and all deck articles remain.

=== Possibly faulty data: explicit PC placings ===

The current original PC sources explicitly number Dan as 7 in the 2024 Worlds Day 1 list, 18 at the 2024 Eclipse Major Day 1, 35 at the 2023 Endor Grand Prix Day 1, and 30 in the 2022 Worlds Day 1 list. The former Wiki values were 8, 40, 32 and 27 respectively; those four cells now follow the printed source numbers. The separate 2024 Worlds Top 8 result of 8 is also explicitly printed and remains, as does the lead's overall Worlds 8th-place statement.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-09-world-championships-bochum-germany-19-22-september-2024/ 2024 Worlds], Players Committee, separate Top 8 and Day 1 lists.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-04-eclipse-major-indianapolis-indiana-apr-5-7/ 2024 Eclipse Major], Players Committee.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-08-endor-grand-prix-seattle-washington-oct-27-29/ 2023 Endor Grand Prix], Players Committee.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-swccg-world-championship/ 2022 Worlds], Players Committee.</ref>

=== Seeds, deck catalogues and elimination stages ===

The 2026 GEMPC source explicitly labels its long deck list Round of 64 (listed by seed); it is not a final standings list. The old 44 is therefore removed from both the lead and Finish cell. The actual Challonge bracket labels Dan seed 43 and shows Andrew Moss defeating him 2–1 in the opening Round of 64. The row and lead now state elimination in that round; 43 remains identified as a seed, not a finishing place.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026 GEMPC], Players Committee, Round of 64 (listed by seed).</ref><ref>[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb 2026 GEMPC bracket], Andrew Moss 2, Dan Tartaglione 1; seed 43.</ref>

Similarly, the old 2025 GEMPC finish of 43 was an unnumbered position in the Round of 64 deck catalogue. Its finish is now blank and its former Day 1 label now says Round of 64, matching the actual source heading. Participation and both decks remain; this edit does not infer a unique final place or an unreported match result.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-05-9th-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2025/ 2025 GEMPC], Players Committee, Round of 64.</ref> The old 2022 Endor Grand Prix Day 1 30 and 2020 Endor Grand Prix Day 1 33 also matched unnumbered catalogue positions without a stated rank, so those finish cells are blank. All event/deck rows remain.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-endor-grand-prix/ 2022 Endor Grand Prix], Players Committee.</ref><ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ 2020 Endor Grand Prix], Players Committee.</ref>

=== Retro League: original standings images checked ===

Nine existing Retro League event finishes were confirmed against the actual final standings, rather than their image filenames: 2024 Events 1/2/3/5 give 17/24/48/39; 2025 Events 1/2/3/4/5 give 57/23/52/24/46. Their ranks remain. The Event 4 2025 source prints the complete final table as text; the other eight were visually checked in the original PNG/JPEG attachments. Twenty complete original standings images, including their continuation pages and the cumulative source below, were independently backed and registered without new Wiki image uploads. The source-page bodies were preserved separately; saving HTML alone does not preserve an attached image's numbers.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1422388#p1422388 2024 Event 1 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425034#p1425034 2024 Event 2 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1428053#p1428053 2024 Event 3 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1432204#p1432204 2024 Event 5 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1435835#p1435835 2025 Event 1 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1440434#p1440434 2025 Event 2 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1439242#p1439242 2025 Event 3 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1440468#p1440468 2025 Event 4 final standings].</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1443266#p1443266 2025 Event 5 final standings].</ref>

The 2024 Event 4 former 25 (tie) cited a cumulative table after Event 4, not that event's final standings. The actual cumulative image puts Dan at 23 with Score 4 = 50; that is a season-total position, not an Event 4 finish. The complete eight-post event topic contains pairings and side/deck statistics but no final placing table. The Event 4 finish is now blank, and its event/format and actual topic source remain. The old cumulative reference was moved here rather than left attached to a claim it does not support. No event rank was derived from cumulative points.<ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1430268#p1430268 Cumulative standings updated after Event 4], Players Committee Forums, 14 October 2024.</ref><ref>[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84006 2024 Retro League Event 4 topic], Players Committee Forums, eight observed posts.</ref>

=== Remaining source limits ===

The 2022 Endor Grand Prix consolation finish of 4 remains an existing claim not independently revalidated here; the checked main-event catalogue and Day 2 update topic did not supply that separate consolation placing. A subsequent cache check confirmed the retained 2025 Retro GEMPC 22nd-place result: a recovered historical standings copy explicitly lists 22 Dan Tartaglione on page 2. The exact recovered copy has now been independently backed and checked. Its relationship to the earlier public snapshot remains qualified: the current public route returns 404, and byte identity with the older public capture has not been established. A cached filename alone is not proof of a capture. The 2022 consolation placing above remains unverified. The printed 2025 Morristown Day 1 14 remains supported by its numbered PC source.<ref>[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2025-02-morristown-melee-morristown-new-jersey-apr-24-27-2025/ 2025 Morristown Melee], Players Committee, Day 1 #14.</ref>

All earlier Talk notes, existing card images, lead choice, team-membership text and card credits remain. Both current Wiki image-version histories and bytes match independently restored existing Git originals; the current public res.starwarsccg.org Dan T card also matches the existing award-card original exactly. Source pages acquired through ordinary public Chrome or FlareSolverr are labeled as DOM derivatives, not raw native HTTP. Exact old values and provenance remain in [[Special:PermanentLink/325157|revision 325157]] and its independent backup. Source captures remain pending with the existing owner, so this is not a claim that preservation or all source conflicts are complete.
